def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    for c in range(w):
        if g[h-1][c]!=5: continue
        nz=[(i,g[i][c]) for i in range(h) if g[i][c]]
        runs=[]
        for i,v in nz:
            if runs and runs[-1][0]==v: runs[-1][2]=i
            else: runs.append([v,i,i])
        for k,(v,s,e) in enumerate(runs):
            start = 0 if k==0 else runs[k-1][2]+1
            for i in range(start,e+1): g[i][c]=v
    return g
